hook.title: Codex approval alerts (optional)
hook.why: Codex doesn't write down when it's waiting for your approval. With this hook, Codex tells Chalito.
hook.steps: Copy this into ~/.codex/hooks.json (or add it to the hooks you already have) and restart Codex. Chalito never edits your ~/.codex folder.
hook.note: The hook prints nothing and decides nothing: Codex keeps asking you as usual. It runs on every approval and every tool Codex uses, and only notes on your computer that an approval is pending, while this option is on.
hook.noCommand: Couldn't find the chalito command on this computer. Install it first (Security › This computer's agent › Install the chalito command) or the hook won't work.
hook.copyFailed: Couldn't copy it. Select the text and copy it by hand.
